children.value: When no single qubit is diagonal, multi-qubit Z₂ symmetries may still exist. A Clifford rotation reveals them.

The symplectic representation of Pauli strings, how to find all Z₂ symmetry generators via GF(2) linear algebra, how to synthesize a Clifford circuit that makes them diagonal, and how FockMap’s unified
Many molecular Hamiltonians have Z₂ symmetries that diagonal-only tapering cannot exploit. Clifford tapering finds and uses them all.
Diagonal tapering requires a qubit where
Hamiltonian term is I or Z. But consider the 2-qubit Heisenberg model:

A 2-qubit problem reduced to 1 qubit — a 2× Hilbert space reduction that diagonal-only tapering would have missed entirely.
